toast.network: The connection dropped. Check it and try again.

failed.undo_one: {{count}} file could not be brought back
failed.undo_other: {{count}} files could not be brought back

reason.size: This file is too large to upload.
reason.invalid: The file was refused: check its name.
reason.forbidden: You are not allowed to upload files.
reason.unknown: The upload failed. Retry, or try again later.
